topic: Data cleaning and next project steps
summary_markdown:
Improvements were made to data processing logic, specifically by removing internal points when the center of one object falls within another's bounding box. This significantly reduced 'junk' objects detected (e.g., on trams).

Regarding project planning, there are several items: an inventory manager and LiDAR integration (mentioned by someone); a news feed for allunite.com (requested by Christina and Linda).
decisions: The current data cleaning logic is effective and has reduced object count.
action_items: Generate and send the newly processed data set.
Investigate the Jira board to understand old tasks and project flow.
Create a large ticket for implementing the news feed on allunite.com.
